items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 19 July 2026 11:07am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 19 July 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Fine today with good sunny spells, although areas of high cloud may make the sunshine a little hazy at times. Light or moderate winds for much of the day, freshening from the northwest this evening. Maximum temperature 20°C, feeling pleasantly warm.


##Outlook##

Staying dry through the working week, with sunny spells and near average temperatures, then at some point next weekend the drought period is likely to finish as rain arrives.
